atoms.text: Over the Easter holidays, your assignment will be to create a project in a format of your choice about something you experience during the break. The due date will be the first day back, and I would like you to submit it either by email or in person on my desk.

instruction.text: Match the words with the same meanings.

atoms.sound: What are you two going to do for your project? I think I will create a photo board of the local wildlife in our area, as I always love going to the park during the holidays!

That sounds really interesting. Do you own a camera? My family and I are going to France on holiday, and we will visit a medieval castle, so I want to make a poster about it using facts I learn and photos I will take on my phone.
I’m so jealous that you are going on holiday! And, yes, I do have my own camera, but it will only be my second time using it. What about you Fatima — what are you going to do?

Well, as history is my favourite subject, I am going to record a short podcast about the industrial revolution in our town. It will be my first time making a podcast, so my friend is going to help me set everything up.

atoms.a: Who is going to spend time in nature?

Which two activities will be available to students in both weeks?
Which activity will help students prepare for their exams?
Which activity is for students studying history?

atoms.sound: Yes, you’re right Reece, it’s available to do in both weeks. I am going to work at a local sports centre, and I hope I will learn some things for my PE exams.
